text:
Two isotopes of carbon are 12C and 14C.
4
Which statement about these two isotopes is correct?
A
Their electronic structure is different.
B
They have different numbers of nucleons.
C
They have different numbers of protons.
D
They have the same number of neutrons.

options.label: B
options.text: They have different numbers of nucleons.

options.label: C
options.text: They have different numbers of protons.

options.label: D
options.text: They have the same number of neutrons.
